test_name: MT202 Full Valid with All Optional Fields
description: Complete MT202 with all optional fields populated. This demonstrates a complex cross-border interbank transfer from Germany to France with correspondent banking chain through US intermediaries.
test_coverage: Block 3 user header with MUR (108) and UETR (121) for gpi tracking
Optional field 56A (Intermediary Institution - JPMorgan Chase US)
Optional field 57A (Account With Institution - Bank of America)
Optional field 58A (Beneficiary Institution - BNP Paribas with account)
Optional field 72 (Sender to Receiver Information with structured codes)
Correspondent banking chain demonstrating complex routing
business_rules_expected_to_pass: All BIC formats valid (DEUTDEFF, COBADEFF, CHASUS33, BOFAUS3N, BNPAFRPP)
Valid UETR UUID format in Block 3
Proper field 72 structured format with /INS/, /ACC/, /BNF/ codes
notes: This MT202 demonstrates a cover payment with full correspondent banking chain. The ordering institution (52A) is Deutsche Bank, which uses Commerzbank as its correspondent (53A). The payment is routed through JPMorgan Chase (56A) to Bank of America (57A), which holds the account for the final beneficiary institution BNP Paribas (58A). Field 72 contains structured information including intermediary instructions (/INS/), account details (/ACC/), and beneficiary information (/BNF/). The UETR in Block 3 enables end-to-end gpi tracking.
